versions.subject: Merge PR #5426 from @norbert791 - New rules: Remote Access Tool MeshAgent
versions.detection:
selection_meshagent:
    - CommandLine|contains: '--meshServiceName'
    - OriginalFileName|contains: 'meshagent'
filter_main_legitimate:
    Image|endswith:
        - '/meshagent'
        - '/meshagent_osx64'
condition: selection_meshagent and not 1 of filter_main_*
